title: Composing and Decomposing Numbers to 10
seo_title: Kindergarten Composing and Decomposing Numbers to 10 Worksheets (TEKS K.2I)
standard_text: K.2I compose and decompose numbers up to 10 with objects and pictures
meta_desc: Free kindergarten worksheets for Texas TEKS K.2I: compose and decompose numbers to 10 with number bonds, two colors, hidden parts and ten frames. 100 questions with answers.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • A number can be broken into two parts: 5 is 3 and 2.
  • The parts put together make the whole.
  • There are many ways: 5 is 4 and 1, 3 and 2, 5 and 0.
  • A ten frame shows how many more make 10.

Examples

Example

7 is 4 and ☐

4 and 3 make 7

Answer: 3

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Giving the whole instead of the partThe part is smaller than the whole.
Counting the shown part againCount only the hidden part.
Missing a wayTry 0 and the whole number too.
